subject_area: Software engineering — process, lifecycle, and project management
key_topics: Agile methods and Scrum sprint ceremonies
Extreme Programming practices (TDD, pair programming, refactoring, user stories)
Requirements engineering (elicitation, specification, validation, change management)
UML system modeling (use case, sequence, class, state diagrams)
Software testing strategies (unit, integration, system, acceptance testing)
Software evolution, legacy systems, and reengineering
Project risk management (identification, analysis, planning, monitoring)
Project scheduling and cost estimation (COCOMO II, algorithmic models)
Software engineering ethics and ACM/IEEE Code of Ethics
one_liner: Software engineering process, lifecycle, and project management — covering SDLC models, agile/Scrum, requirements engineering, UML modeling, testing strategies, software evolution, project planning, and cost estimation (COCOMO II) — does NOT cover programming language implementation, specific frameworks, databases, infrastructure, or deployment.
